baseline_id: B0-source best_agents(worlds=128) dd_left=6 search_showing=1, seed map seed+2*seat

candidate_id.primary: C1-shadow-v1 (beta frozen on FIT; M, n frozen on PLAN)
candidate_id.separate_variant: C1-natural-v1 (own-stream advancement; a different complete policy)

do_not_launch_reason: Disabled: no owner approval and no numeric CPU/wall/memory caps; CONFIRM size unset; futility rule is only proposed

estimator_version.allocation: min over integer n of max_a(A_a/M + B_a/n) at the W128 baseline's measured CPU, from PLAN data only
estimator_version.beta: single scalar: slope from fit_beta_on_split (FIT only; within-case/action centred, equal case weights), frozen as optimal_beta(slope, M, n) once M, n are fixed on PLAN
estimator_version.reference_action: clone preferred legal discard, engine tie order

failure_policy: retain failures; no complete-case deletion or unlabelled replacement

independent_reference_plan.rule: all legal actions on fresh explicit worlds, independent of the candidate, baseline and selection streams

lifecycle_contract.case_harvest: independent_cold_bundle v3 deals, B0-source best agents at every seat
lifecycle_contract.mechanism_endpoint: decision-case replay: every case evaluated from a fresh cold agent fork (ReplayFork/NativeFork); no controller state carried between cases

match_censoring_policy: record unresolved and bounds; no automatic half-win
multiplicity_plan: one nominated candidate (shadow); the natural variant is reported descriptively
opponent_population: the same frozen W128 family at every other seat (case harvesting)
planning_constraint: Measured on fixtures: a W128 NOLO discard costs 0.03-0.3 s CPU while a bid search costs 2-6 s (builds/parity_B0-source.json). The discard branch is therefore likely a small CPU fraction f, and the total saving is bounded by f*r (statistics.total_saving_bound). Measure f first; if f < 0.2 the full-game '20% total CPU' promotion route is arithmetically unreachable for C1 and only the local MSE endpoint or a separately powered strength test remains.
proposed_futility_rule: stop C1 after PLAN if the upper 95% bound of the reference-noise-corrected MSE ratio at equal CPU is >= 0.9 (proposal; needs approval)

proposed_resource_shape.note: native search already uses every core; nested concurrency untested

reference_noise_adjustment: statistics.mse_endpoints: corrected ratio and MSE difference
sample_size_basis: PLAN paired-cluster SD of the MSE-difference endpoint -> statistics.power_n; not historical SDs

score_distribution.note: one declared law; legacy 'uniform' is not uniform over 25 states

secondary_endpoints: paired selected-value difference on fresh common validation worlds
branch frequency and CPU fraction f
CPU/wall including sampling, shadow, proxy and reference

seed_namespace.agents: per-bundle seat seeds (runner_v3.bundle_seed); cases forked from them

CONFIRM.rule: sized from PLAN variance after a candidate is nominated; opened once

stream_protocol: shadow advancement: candidate streams hash a copy of the agent's pre-call scalar RNG state (actor-local, distinct per agent and call, reproduced by forks); the persistent RNG is then advanced by W root draws exactly as W128 (V09)
